root.label: Trump administration begins imposing migrant fines

events.label: Trump administration begins imposing migrant fines

slots.name: daily fine amount
slots.sentence: Last year, the Trump administration began imposing fines of $998 per day for migrants who did not leave the country following a final order of deportation.

slots.name: retroactive fine period
slots.sentence: The fines have been imposed retroactively for up to five years, with a maximum penalty of $1.8 million.
